lines.t: 1 One commandment broken, are all commandments broken?
Once sin committed in the Messiah's name Are all sins accounted to you
Once sin repented in His name All are forgiven you
For I know your thoughts, my children Even your innermost intentions
And I know whether or not you are Fully converted in your hearts
And though you may lie to yourselves
And bear false witness in the sight of many witnesses
Nothing is hidden from the eyes of God
Every lie exposed, every heart laid bare
In the day I rise up and charge the earth
Come to me, therefore in sincerity and truth
Humble yourselves in the Messiah's name
For He is the true light
Utterly light of darkness
The only way to follow the truth absolute
By Him alone shall you walk into everlasting life
For only those who walk in Him shall find me
And only those in union with Him shall know me
For only those who walk in Him shall find me
And only those in union with Him shall know me
Says the Lord
Thank you.
